Extra attempts cannot repair failures; unproved redelivery stops; late extras reduce affected completion without erasing history or authorized-dispatch/missing/unstarted inventories; conditional structural pairs confer no real completion.

Real configuration/trusted receipts remain unavailable, costs null and `benchmark_ready=false`; actual admissions, model/reader/native executions, scored runs, semantic passes and real comparisons remain zero; no historical suites, evaluator or product execution ran.
Next work requires separately scoped integration review; resume from these pins and saved cases, preserving the initial expectations and avoiding repeated F2 probes, old suites, broad history or expectation rederivation after outcome exposure.
